content: De7o haathinnee mith
Yeypp guye, kiitanchchay tana Xooss zufaanayppennee Duray zufaanaypp goggiz burcuko garkk pociz gita de7o haath ta beezeeza.

Ye haathata ye katamitii waanna goossa qoo7ii aadhiza. Ye haathatis ushach baggarannee haddiris baggar laytha taphpho nam77ii toke aginar aginar aafiz de7o mithii yeza. Ye mithatii hayitay woya pathiza.
Yhanpp guye aba baadithii yezaamii. Xooss zufaanaynnee Duray zufaanay ye katamayid yezoda. E ayllitay Eza goynnoda.
Unttii e aafa be7ada; e sunthay u sinol xaafinttoda.
Yikkepp guye qamma baaya; Goda Xoossay unttis poo7iza maaqqeez gishos unttis xomppe woy awa poo7o koshshooya. Unttii medhdhii medhinas kawutoda.
Yesuusa maaqqii yi7ith

Yeypp guye Kiitanchchay taako, «Yha ta odiza qaalay ammantteezitannee tumita. Goda Xoossay, nabitayis fa Ayyanar inggizay, ukker attekka hanod baz fa ayllita beessadayis fa kiitanchcha azazeeza» yeegeeza.
Yesuusakka, «Yeezako ta eller ye7oda; yha maxaafayid yez tinbbite qaala naagiza oonkka anjjintteezaya» yeegeeza.
Ta, Waannisa, ye ubbabaza si7eezannee be7eeza. Taanii yeya si7eez wodennee be7eez wode yeya tana beezeez kiitanchcha goynnodayis e tokayil afa guphinggeeza.
Zini kiitanchchay taako, «Ashshoba! Yeya oothippe! Taanii ne garkke, ne ishitay nabitay garkkennee yha maxaafayid yez ubba kiitinttiza ayllitay garkke; Xoossis goynnoba» yeegeeza.
Yhaypp guye Kiitanchchay mahii, «Yha ubbay polinttiza woday ukkeez gishos yha maxaafayid xaafintteez tinbbite qaala maatamer gorddippe.
Iita oothizay gujjii iita ootho; tunaykka gujjii tuno. Xillaykka gujjii xillo; geezhizay gujjii geezho» yeegeeza.
Yesuusa, «Yeezako, taanii ellisii ye7oda. Pettayis pettayis e oosay garkk immad woyitay taar yeza.
Taanii Alfannee Oomega; Tiinannee Guya; Dendonnee wursitha.
«Fa ma7a meeccii geeshsheezitay anjjintteezita. De7o mith aafa maadayisinnee katamit pengitayir gelodayis unttis mawute inggitteeza.
Zini kanitay, bitizitay, lagitizitay, shemppo wodhizitay, eeqa goynnizitay, worddo dosizitayinnee oothizitay baler yeza.
«Ta, Yesuusa, yha markkatitha yinttis, woosa keethitayis ododay garkk ta kiitanchcha kiiteeza. Taanii Dawute sheeshinnee zerithi. Taanii poo7iza guura bakkala xoolintta» yeegeeza.
Ayyaanaynnee gelodayis giigeez maachchat, «Yhana ye7oba» yeegiza. Ma yhaya si7iz oonkka, «Yhana ye7oba» yeego. Saamintteez oonkka yhana ye7o; de7o haath koyiz oonkka ciga bayth cer ekkii uzho.
Taanii yha maxaafayid xaafintteez tinbbite qaala si7iz oonakka naaginttoday garkk markattiza. Oonkka yha qaalayil afa pettibaz gujjiko, Xoossii yha maxaafayid xaafintteez bosha ezal afa gujjoda.
Oonkka maxaafayid yez tinbbite qaalaypp pettibaz pacinchiko, Xoossii yha maxaafayid xaafintteez de7o mith aafeppennee geesh katamitipp e anja pacinthoda.
Yha ubba markkattizay, «Tuma, taanii ellisii ye7oda» yeegiza. Amin77ii; Goda Yesuusa, ye7oda.
Goda Yesuus aadho keehatithay nu ubbayir maaqqo. Amin77ii.

footnotes.text: Pettii pettii Grike maxapitayid ye de7o mithay Katama waana goossayisinnee goggiz hathyis gancce yeza yeegiza.
